description: Complete catalog of tools included in the Excelsior rescue environment

tools.name: testdisk
tools.description: Recovers lost partitions and fixes boot sectors for FAT, NTFS, ext2/3/4, and more

tools.name: photorec
tools.description: File carving tool — recovers photos, documents, video from damaged/formatted media

tools.name: ddrescue
tools.description: Forensic disk copying — maps and works around bad sectors

tools.name: extundelete
tools.description: Recovers deleted files from ext3/ext4 filesystems

tools.name: gparted
tools.description: Graphical partition editor — resize, create, delete, move, copy partitions

tools.name: parted
tools.description: GNU Parted — CLI partition manipulation supporting MBR and GPT

tools.name: gdisk
tools.description: GPT fdisk — partitioning tool specifically for GPT disks

tools.name: smartmontools
tools.description: S.M.A.R.T. monitoring — check drive health, predict failure

tools.name: hdparm
tools.description: Get and set hard disk parameters, benchmarking, ATA secure erase

tools.name: badblocks
tools.description: Surface scan to find and mark bad sectors on block devices

tools.name: ntfs-3g
tools.description: Read/write NTFS volumes from Linux — mount Windows partitions

tools.name: e2fsprogs
tools.description: ext2/3/4 filesystem utilities — fsck, mkfs, tune2fs, debugfs

tools.name: dosfstools
tools.description: FAT filesystem utilities — mkfs.fat, fsck.fat

tools.name: chntpw
tools.description: Offline Windows password reset and registry editor
tools.replaces: NT Password Editor, Offline NT Password & Registry Editor

tools.name: ophcrack
tools.description: Windows password cracker using rainbow tables (LM and NTLM hashes)

tools.name: clamav
tools.description: Offline antivirus scanner — scan Windows partitions from Linux
tools.replaces: Malwarebytes, McAfee Stinger, Kaspersky Virus Removal

tools.name: chkrootkit
tools.description: Locally checks for signs of a rootkit

tools.name: rkhunter
tools.description: Rootkit Hunter — scans for rootkits, backdoors, and local exploits

tools.name: grub-install
tools.description: Reinstall GRUB2 bootloader on any disk from a running rescue system

tools.name: efibootmgr
tools.description: Manage UEFI boot entries — add, remove, reorder boot options

tools.name: os-prober
tools.description: Detect operating systems installed on all partitions

tools.name: hwinfo
tools.description: Detailed hardware detection and information tool

tools.name: inxi
tools.description: Full system information report (CPU, RAM, disks, GPU, network)

tools.name: dmidecode
tools.description: Dump DMI/SMBIOS data — BIOS, motherboard, memory slots

tools.name: stress-ng
tools.description: Stress test CPU, memory, I/O — useful for stability testing

tools.name: memtester
tools.description: Userspace memory tester — tests RAM from within the rescue OS

tools.name: htop
tools.description: Interactive process viewer and system monitor

tools.name: btop
tools.description: Beautiful resource monitor — CPU, RAM, disk, network

tools.name: nmap
tools.description: Network scanner and security auditing tool

tools.name: wireshark
tools.description: Network protocol analyzer — capture and analyze packets

tools.name: openssh
tools.description: SSH client and server — remote access to/from rescue environment

tools.name: rsync
tools.description: Fast file transfer and synchronization — local and remote

tools.name: mc
tools.description: Midnight Commander — dual-pane file manager (Norton Commander-style)

tools.name: hexedit
tools.description: Terminal hex editor — view and edit binary files

tools.name: nano
tools.description: Simple terminal text editor

tools.name: vim
tools.description: Advanced terminal text editor

tools.name: p7zip
tools.description: 7-Zip command-line — extract ZIP, 7z, RAR, TAR and more

tools.name: memtest86plus
tools.description: Standalone memory tester — boots natively (BIOS and UEFI), tests RAM before OS loads
tools.replaces: Memtest86, RAM tester in old HBCD
